limitations: Five matched worlds in four-clue strata; eight elsewhere; one repetition.
Worlds, not variants or agent calls, are independent sampling units.
All original assignments, including one provider failure, stay in score denominators.
Costs use frozen standard paid rates, not provider invoices; all earlier holds remain reserved.
Synthetic structured constraints plus deterministic rendered text; not natural-language-only.
Nuisance components are recognizable and independent, not adversarial prose.
Four versus eight necessary clues also changes suspect count; not an isolated depth effect.
Corrupted cases are selected for certified at-most-two-false answerability; minimum subset costs are bounded, not fixed.
Distributed sharing forwards original reports deterministically; not learned communication or model discussion.
Supported correctness certifies answer availability, not a model reasoning trace.
Exploratory demonstrations, not significance claims, a leaderboard or broad model-weakness claims.
Some preplanned complete-information baselines and fully delivered sharing conditions have identical prompts; they are repeated observations of the same world, not independent cases.

preplanned_prompt_overlap.interpretation: Separate preplanned conditions can deliver the same prompt. These are repeated observations of the same world, not independent samples. No failed dispatch is retried. Temperature zero does not establish observed output reproducibility; compare saved outcomes for these preplanned duplicates.

dataset_profile_scope: Profiles retain counts and verified bounds. Full proof-search cuts and certificates remain in the original frozen bundles, identified by dataset file hashes.
